---
title: My Wave
---

**My Wave** is a personal infinite stream of tracks generated by the Yandex Music recommendation engine (Rotor). The stream updates in real time based on your listening history and likes.

## Access

- **Browse:** open **Browse → Yandex Music → My Wave** to view the playlist.
- **Recommendations (Discover):** My Wave also appears on the MA home screen and updates every 10 minutes.

## How It Works

The provider uses the Yandex Music Rotor API — the same engine behind My Wave in the official app:

1. Tracks are loaded in batches (a few tracks per request).
2. Already-played tracks are filtered out — no duplicates appear.
3. With each track play, the provider sends feedback to Rotor (start / end / skip) — this improves personalization.
4. The playlist supports pagination: more tracks can be loaded in Browse.

## Configuring the Limit

By default, up to **150 tracks** are loaded. This can be changed in the provider settings:

**Settings → Yandex Music → My Wave — max tracks** (advanced settings, range 10–1000).

A lower value means faster loading. A higher value means a longer uninterrupted stream without repeats.

## Feedback and Personalization

The provider automatically sends the following to Rotor:
- **start** — a track began playing.
- **end** — a track was played to the end.
- **skip** — a track was skipped.

This feedback affects future recommendations exactly as it does in the official app.
